messages.subject: error while running scantwo with HK method
parts:
Hello

I'm running scantwo of TACC culster using snow. I can run it with multi-cluster using "mr" or "mr-imp" methods but when I use "hk" method, it's giving the following error:

*** caught segfault ***
address 0x7ffbcaa7efd8, cause 'memory not mapped'

Even I can run "hk" method with n.cluster=1 without any error.

Has anybody faced the same error before?

Thanks in advance!

Taslima
